pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, 9.exd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave ...Qh4 through the e7-bishop; plan 3 called f2, g3 and h2 light squares when they are dark. Rewrote plans 1 and 3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, 9.exd5 Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave ...Bb7, ...Qh4 (through the e7-bishop) and ...Re6-g6 before the exchanges on e5. Rewrote plan 1 around the main line. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, Main Line, 13.Re1 Qh4 14.g3
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave a rook lift ...Rf6-h6 with the f-pawn on f7. Rewrote plan 1. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, Main Line, 13.Re2
pages.notes: Plan 1 brought the rook via ...Re8-e6-g6 with no rook on e8; plan 2 gave Rh2 through the f2-pawn. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, Main Line, 15.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 4 pushed d5 into the d5-knight; plan 2 gave Qd2 rather than the main-line Qd3; plan 1 repeated ...Re8 and ...Rae8. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, Main Line, 15.Be3 Bg4 16.Qd3
pages.notes: Overview called 16...Bg4 a pin when the bishop came to g4 on move 15 to attack the queen; plan 2 routed the knight Nd2-f1-g3 onto the g3-pawn. Rewrote overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, Main Line, 15.Be3 Bg4 16.Qd3 Rae8
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a pin on f3 where there is no piece; plan 2 routed the knight onto the g3-pawn. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, Main Line, 16.Qd3 Rae8 17.Nd2
pages.notes: Plan 2 played Nf1-g3 onto the g3-pawn; plan 4 gave a3 and b4 instead of the main-line a4. Rewrote plans 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Marshall, Main Line, Classical, 18.Qf1
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote White's a4 as Black's ...a4. Rewrote plan 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave the route Nf1-g3-f5 with no knight on f1; plan 2 gave ...d5 and the Breyer as ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.
